coverage.one_liner: python3 -c "import json,subprocess;d=json.load(open('plans/architecture-debt-audit/stations/sddp/inventory.json'));b=d['baseline'];a=[f['path'] for f in d['src']['files']];f=set(subprocess.run(['git','ls-tree','-r',b,'--name-only','--','crates/cobre-sddp/src'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.split());f={p for p in f if p.endswith('.rs')};assert len(a)==len(set(a)),'double-assigned';assert set(a)==f,sorted(set(a)^f);r=d['substation_rollup'];assert sum(v['file_count'] for v in r.values())==len(f);assert sum(v['total_lines'] for v in r.values())==d['src']['total_lines'];print('coverage OK',len(f))"
